_doc: Example 1 — effective source_type override only (the common case). Use when the heuristic classifier mislabeled a source you've manually verified. Override does NOT clear any severities; if R-003/R-005/R-009 fire on this source, the quarantine stays in effect.
reason: AEA peer-reviewed Applied Economics article landing page; reclassify as primary because the extractor returned (untitled) and source_type defaulted to unknown.

_doc: Example 2 — clear_severities to lift a quarantine the operator has confirmed is a false-positive. The R-009 identity-mismatch fired because the extractor returned an empty title, but the fetched HTML <title> is clearly on-topic. clear_severities[] is monotonic-union per source_id (later overrides cannot un-clear). Combine with a new_source_type override when the same correction also reclassifies the source.
reason: Fetched HTML title 'Spring forward to daylight saving time brings surge in fatal car crashes' is on-topic; extractor returned (untitled). Severity is extractor failure, not real identity mismatch.
